applications.name: boulevard-watchlist
applications.title: Boulevard Ticker Watchlist
applications.description: Live BBO for a hand-picked list of tickers. Clicking a row broadcasts fdc3.instrument context to any connected app on the same channel.

applications.name: boulevard-oms-order-entry
applications.title: Boulevard OMS Order Entry
applications.description: L2 depth and a mock order ticket for whichever ticker is currently active - driven by fdc3.instrument context, or a manual ticker override for standalone use.
